name: fleet-management-system
description: Task entry points. The single source of truth for every command, so the project needs neither GNU make nor a POSIX shell - both absent from a default Windows box. CI runs these same scripts.

scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run types && pnpm run test
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:go && pnpm run lint:web
scripts.lint:web: cd frontend && pnpm exec biome check .
scripts.fmt: cd frontend && pnpm exec biome check --write . && cd ../backend && go fmt ./...
scripts.test: pnpm run test:go && pnpm run test:web
scripts.test:web: cd frontend && pnpm exec vitest run
scripts.build: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:console && pnpm run build:server
scripts.test:e2e: cd e2e && pnpm exec playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:install: cd e2e && pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
